interest: Shows 1937 Philippine vetting of the Bank of Taiwan via Shanghai banking circles, recalling the 1927 Showa crisis.
overview: Gauss reports to McNutt that Shanghai bankers rate the Bank of Taiwan favorably despite 1927 crisis troubles tied to the Kanto Earthquake, for a proposed Manila branch; an ad lists its capital, officers, and worldwide branches.

subfiles.about: U.S. Consul General C. E. Gauss reports on inquiries made into the reputation, financial standing, and business practices of the Bank of Taiwan regarding its application to open a Manila branch.
subfiles.from: C. E. Gauss, American Consul General, Shanghai
subfiles.summary: Gauss tells McNutt Shanghai banks view the Bank of Taiwan favorably, with its 1927 crisis seen locally as a past Kanto Earthquake aftereffect, not an ongoing concern.
